none: PAS NLM-EAB9C3: Roman Coin: Nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Gratian (367-383), probably a Gloria Novi Saeculi issue of Arles mint, 367-375, Reece period 19. Obverse description: [bust]. Reverse description: Emperor standing right with standard, shield propped to right; an unusually animated posture. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI]. In exergue: possibly OF [--]. Diameter: 18.0mm, Weight: 1.63gms
